title: Register group mobility patterns in scenario DSL registry
description: MOBILITY_PATTERNS (scenario.py:252) only registers random_waypoint; the new GroupMobility (jitter), RPGM, and ManhattanGrid classes are public API but unreachable from YAML mobility events. Register names (e.g. group_waypoint, rpgm, manhattan_grid), pass params through, and add parse/exec tests mirroring the random_waypoint ones. Also document per-group seed derivation or add duplicate-seed guard to avoid correlated lockstep groups.
